ref.description: Full ref name, eg. refs/heads/main or refs/tags/v1.0

sha.description: Object SHA the ref points at. Width depends on the repo's git object-format.

errors.name: RepoNotFound
errors.description: Repo is not registered on this knot

cursor.description: Cursor for the next page, absent when the last page is reached

repo.description: DID of the git repo as minted by the knot

limit.description: Maximum number of refs to return in this page

main.description: List every ref & its commit SHA for a git repo, equivalent to git ls-remote. Gives the full ref state of a repo.

ref.description: Default branch ref name that HEAD points at, eg. refs/heads/main.

head.description: Commit SHA at the tip of the default branch, for reconciling against a last-known state. Width depends on the repo's git object-format.
